component.name: Leita
component.summary: See what is filling a drive, and report on it

description.p: Leita shows what is using the disk as the scan finds it: the chart fills in while it reads, as a sunburst, a treemap or an icicle, and any folder opens to show what fills it.

It finds what can be deleted and made again, such as build output and caches, and writes a scan up as a CSV, JSON, HTML or PDF report. Scanning and cleaning up are free for personal use; reports need a licence. It sends nothing anywhere but a licence key, once, to activate it.
